facets.statement: Ön kesici dişin tamamen düşmesi veya bir kısmının kırılması temel anlam alanıdır.
Eylem başkasının ağzına vurup onu ön dişi kırık veya eksik hale getirmeyi de kapsar.
Hasar kişinin üzerinde kalan ön dişi kırık ya da eksik olma niteliğiyle de anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: The source phrase consistently points to damage to a front incisor: the tooth may fall out, part of it may be broken, or someone may cause that condition by striking the mouth. The provisional framing matches this evidence when it is kept to the front-tooth injury and its resulting state.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: The branch excludes other body damage or named places; those appear only as comparisons or unrelated names.

lexicalization_scope.note: The mechanical profile marks the branch as unresolved, so the definition does not claim an unrestricted bare-root range beyond the supplied front-incisor damage and causation.

source_summary: Supplied evidence agrees on a front-incisor injury: the tooth may fall out, part of it may break, or the injury may be caused by hitting someone in the mouth. The same claim also links the resulting description to a person left with that front-tooth defect.
